   - `claude-worktree-busy <main>` must exit 0.
4. Pull: `git -C <main> pull --ff-only`.
5. Remove the worktree: `git -C <main> worktree remove <main>/.claude/worktrees/mobile-nav`. No `--force`.
6. Delete the local branch: `git -C <main> branch -d worktree-mobile-nav`. Use `-d`, not `-D`.
7. Delete the remote branch: `git -C <main> push origin --delete worktree-mobile-nav`.
